dev.note: This identifies the repository baseline inspected by the program proposal, not an operator runtime.

legacy_installation.reason: Repository source shows installer/update/rollback behavior but contains no exact installed artifact digest, source-commit-bound release manifest, qualification manifest, or owner promotion record.

invariants: absence of a recorded stable release must not be repaired by silently treating mutable main as stable
ocode default may point to stable only after an exact immutable artifact has been qualified and explicitly promoted
candidate and dev require explicit selectors
promotion selects an existing candidate artifact and never rebuilds it
rollback selects retained prior stable and preserves failed-release evidence
